US Judge Dismisses Trump Administration's Antisemitism Lawsuit Against Harvard

A federal judge in Boston has dismissed a lawsuit filed by the Trump administration alleging that Harvard University failed to protect Jewish students. The lawsuit claimed the university did not adequately combat antisemitism during pro-Palestinian protests following the October 7, 2023, Hamas attacks on Israel. The judge ruled that the incidents cited by the Department of Justice were "too isolated and episodic" to prove a violation of civil rights law, calling them "isolated and episodic."
